name: Old Site Deactivation Verification
description: Confirms that the original Carrillo Inc site (location_id 840) has been correctly deactivated after the shutdown request

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM location WHERE location_id = 840 AND name = 'Carrillo Inc Site A - Tokyo' AND city = 'tokyo' AND country = 'japan' AND active = 0;

name: Alternate Site Reactivation Verification
description: Ensures that the alternate Carrillo Inc site (location_id 839) has been reactivated to support relocation of the installed product.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM location WHERE location_id = 839 AND name = 'Carrillo Inc Hq - Japan' AND city = 'tokyo' AND country = 'japan' AND active = 1;

name: Installed Product Relocation Verification
description: Validates that the target device with serial number P97-245230-8224 (installed_product_id 98) was successfully moved to the reactivated site (location_id 839).

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM installed_product WHERE installed_product_id = 98 AND account_id = 19 AND product_id = 97 AND serial_number = 'P97-245230-8224' AND location_id = 839 AND status = 'in_use';

name: Product status changed to 'in_use'
description: Validates that all the products at the newly re-activated location have status as 'in_use'

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM installed_product WHERE installed_product_id = 102 AND account_id = 19 AND product_id = 229 AND serial_number = 'P229-742915-6468' AND location_id = 839 AND status = 'in_use';
